result.topic_en: A transformation formula for the infinite product (1-q^{1^s})(1-q^{2^s})(1-q^{3^s})..., with q=e^{-2πx}, expressed as a double product over λ and odd n, followed by the special cases s=1, 2, 3.
result.transcription:
(72)
Add Ms a 94 18(72)
See 'A Glance[?] on CAn[?]'

$(1-q^{1^s})(1-q^{2^s})(1-q^{3^s})(1-q^{4^s})\dots\dots$

$(2\pi x)^{\frac12} e^{\pi x\zeta(-s)}(1-e^{-2\pi x.1^s})(1-e^{-2\pi x.2^s})(1-e^{-2\pi x.3^s})\dots$
$=(2\pi)^{\frac12 s} e^{-\frac{\pi\zeta(-\frac1s)}{x^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi}{2s}}}\prod\prod_{\lambda=1}^{\lambda=\infty}\left\{1-2e^{-2\pi(\frac{\lambda}{x})^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi n}{2s}}\cos\left(2\pi(\frac{\lambda}{x})^{\frac1s}\cos\frac{\pi n}{2s}\right)+e^{-4\pi(\frac{\lambda}{x})^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi n}{2s}}\right\}^{\frac12}$
$n=1,3,5,7,\dots\dots 2s-1.$

$s=1,$ $\sqrt{x}\,e^{-\frac{\pi x}{12}}(1-e^{-2\pi x})(1-e^{-4\pi x})(1-e^{-6\pi x})\dots=e^{-\frac{\pi}{12x}}(1-e^{-\frac{2\pi}{x}})(1-e^{-\frac{4\pi}{x}})\dots$

$s=2,$ $\frac12\sqrt{(\frac{x}{\pi})}\,e^{-\frac{2\pi}{\sqrt{x}}\zeta(-\frac12)}(1-e^{-\pi x})(1-e^{-4\pi x})(1-e^{-9\pi x})(1-e^{-16\pi x})\dots$
$=\prod_{\lambda=1}^{\lambda=\infty}\left\{1-2e^{-2\pi\sqrt{(\frac{\lambda}{x})}}\cos(2\pi\sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{x}})+e^{-4\pi\sqrt{(\frac{\lambda}{x})}}\right\}.$

$s=3,$ $\sqrt{x}\,e^{\frac{\pi x}{120}-\frac{2\pi\zeta(-\frac13)}{\sqrt[3]{x}}}(1-e^{-2\pi x})(1-e^{-16\pi x})(1-e^{-54\pi x})\dots$
$=2\pi\prod_{\lambda=1}^{\lambda=\infty}\left\{(1-e^{-\pi\sqrt[3]{\frac{\lambda}{x}}})\left(1-2e^{-\pi\sqrt[3]{\frac{\lambda}{x}}}\cos(\pi\sqrt3\sqrt[3]{\frac{\lambda}{x}})+e^{-2\pi\sqrt[3]{\frac{\lambda}{x}}}\right)\right\},$
